row: Chiropassion Consulting provides expert advice to grow your business and achieve your goals. Do you want to improve your practice skills, financial success and overall life enjoyment? Do you want to close the gap pf where you are and where you want to be? Chiropassion Consulting offers you the opportunity to join our personalized, passionate and successful Chiropractic Coaching Program, where you have the access to train personally and with your staff anytime, anywhere! We offer three online programs through our website which includes our Mastery Gold, Mastery Elite and Mastery Student. Additionally, Dr. Joe Borio offers in person consulting events where CE credits are offered. Dr. Borio and CPC puts on four events throughout the country each year as well as one event at Dr. Joe Borio's practice, Borio Chiropractic Health Center.
